# County archives courier pickup

The county archives sends a courier to the Harlow Junction branch on the first Monday of each month to collect boxes of township records that residents drop off for preservation. The branch only holds the boxes in the back office until the courier arrives; library staff do not open or sort them.

If the courier misses a pickup, call the archives front desk. Boxes should be taped shut and labeled with the township name. See also [[Food pantry route consolidation]] for another partner that uses a branch as a drop point.
